dataList.content:
Woah, I can't believe they're letting us in like this!
哇，门卫先生们不知何时把路让开了呢。
dataList.place:
Marlin Port Club Entrance
马林鱼港船 会所前

dataList.content:
I wanted to correct him that the bouncers weren't letting us in, that they were either face-down in some ditch or fleeing, and we were just letting ourselves in...
虽然我本想说这些保安可不是让路了，而是都七横八竖地倒在地上，或者早就抱头鼠窜了……

But I guess I wasn't in the mood.
但我没心情这么说。

Heyy... you here with anyone?
嘿，你们来了几位啊？
dataList.place:
Marlin Port Club Entrance
马林鱼港船 会所前
dataList.title:

dataList.content:
Yes. I have twelve companions with me.
一共十三名。

dataList.title:
U Corp.
U公司
dataList.content:
Aaah! S-sorry for disturbing you!
噫……对、对不起！

dataList.title:

dataList.content:
Okay everyone~ Let's do the famous 'Marlin Dance' of our beloved Marlin port!
好~各位一起来跳那个风靡本港的马林鱼舞吧！

dataList.title:

U公司
dataList.content:
Arms out~ Like this! Swing~ and lock! Swing~ and lock!
伸开双臂~像这样！哗啦啦~啪！哗啦啦~啪！

Ngh... what's with all the booming bass?
妈的……这里怎么这么震啊？

It feels as though the sound waves are vibrating my entire brain matter...
感觉大脑在嗡嗡作响……

Get out of my way or you'll all be sorry.
如果不想受伤的话。就都给我从眼前消失。

Ishmael swung her mace, shattering a nearby table to pieces...
以实玛利挥舞着硬头锤，粉碎了附近的桌子，发出一声巨响……

And that was more than enough for the clubbers to realize the seriousness of the situation. They quickly ran to the exit and vacated the club.
目睹了这非比寻常的场面的客人们争先恐后逃离了会所。
